findings.summary: Columbia Firehouse at 109 S St Asaph St is permanently closed; current owner and exact-address sources identify Josephine as the active restaurant.
The baseline's Toast URL retains a Columbia Firehouse slug but its live identity, menu, address, and phone are Josephine. All 24 baseline rows were extracted from the successor restaurant.
The packet domain redirects to an unrelated site blocked as suspected phishing and must not be used as restaurant authority.

No current comprehensive allergen matrix, ingredient guide, or cross-contact policy was found. Josephine's official gluten-free menu is preparation-specific and generic Toast allergy controls are request modifiers.

The current Josephine union contains 103 unique products across dinner, lunch, brunch, happy/midday, fromage, dessert/coffee, gluten-free, and Toast surfaces; alcohol was excluded while nonalcoholic drinks were retained.

The baseline omitted direct positives visible in current descriptions, including peanut for the kids peanut-butter sandwich, fish/milk/tree-nut for Trout Amandine, and milk/tree-nut for Seared Scallops.

proposedChanges: Mark Columbia Firehouse Alexandria closed/replaced and stop treating the live legacy-slug Toast menu as Columbia Firehouse.
Represent all 24 frozen rows as location-mismatched Josephine products rather than current Columbia Firehouse matches.
Replace the partial 24-row successor menu with the complete 103-product current Josephine union solely for identity/reconciliation context.
Quarantine the former columbiafirehouse.com domain as unsafe/unrelated and use current NRG, Josephine, and exact linked Toast sources.
Retain only explicit direct allergen positives; do not convert a gluten-free presentation menu or generic allergy request modifiers into blanket negative or cross-contact claims.
